_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

county.label: County
county.expects: a Maine county name (the form prints 'COUNTY'/'Probate Court'); rendered upper-case, without the word 'County'

docket_no.label: Docket No
avoid: a docket from another jurisdiction's format

individual_name.label: Individual Name
individual_name.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

conservatorship_grant_date.label: Conservatorship Grant Date
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

report_reasons.label: Report Reasons
report_reasons.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

court_order_date.label: Court Order Date
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

report_period_start.label: Report Period Start
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

report_period_end.label: Report Period End
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

services_provided.label: Services Provided
services_provided.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

recommended_changes.label: Recommended Changes
recommended_changes.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

de_minimis_value_received.label: De Minimis Value Received
de_minimis_value_received.expects: a dollar amount, digits and decimal point only
avoid: a '$' character inside the value (the form prints it)
a negative amount unless this line is explicitly a credit

business_relation_provider.label: Business Relation Provider
business_relation_provider.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

business_relation_paid.label: Business Relation Paid
business_relation_paid.expects: a dollar amount, digits and decimal point only
avoid: a '$' character inside the value (the form prints it)
a negative amount unless this line is explicitly a credit

coconservator_status.label: Coconservator Status
coconservator_status.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

approved_plan_date.label: Approved Plan Date
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

report_date.label: Report Date
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

conservator_printed_name.label: Conservator Printed Name
conservator_printed_name.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

attorney_name.label: Attorney Name
attorney_name.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

attorney_address.label: Attorney Address
attorney_address.expects: an address with: street, city, state, zip
avoid: the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
a PO box where a physical/legal residence is required
